title: vc-rollup: companion artifact for Joint anonymized issuance and revocation for complex verifiable credential chains
description: Companion artifact for the 2026 TDK paper by Kocsis Csillag Kamilla. Implements credential query proofs, three accumulators, public issuance and ledger-enforced public guarded updates. Private update guards are rejected; private presentations remain off-chain. Includes reproducible local evaluation and historical OP Sepolia evidence; see design/ENFORCED-GUARDS.md for scope and limitations.
